data.what_it_does: Provides the web platform implementation for the cloud_firestore package, allowing Flutter apps to interact with Cloud Firestore on the web.
use_when: Building a Flutter web application that uses Cloud Firestore
Using cloud_firestore in a multi-platform app targeting web
strengths: Enables Cloud Firestore support on Flutter web
Integrates seamlessly with Firebase core web packages
weaknesses: Platform-specific implementation package that is usually not imported directly
data.setup_notes: Refer to the Firebase documentation for quickstart and setup instructions.
